pages.title: Immunisation
pages.text: $(thing)Immunisation$()$(br2)Show the body a harmless trace of an invader and it is ready for the real one. Unlocks an Anomaly Ward for each of the Anomaly's infections.

$(thing)Insight$(): 140$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Antibodies.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Antibody, 2 Fractured Essence.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A disease spreads at R0. Write the share H that must be held safe so each case makes less than one more (herd immunity).
